name: Eggplant Parmesan with Tomato Sauce and Mozzarella

components.name: Eggplant Parmesan

ingredients.name: Raw eggplant, sliced into thin rounds
Panko crumbs, includes potentially unused coating
Raw beaten whole egg, without shell
Tomato marinara with no meat, purchased before baking

steps: Preheat oven to 200 C. Coat eggplant rounds lightly in beaten egg then panko mixed with vegetarian hard cheese and herbs; shake off unused coating.
Arrange coated slices on oiled lined trays and roast 20-25 minutes until golden, flipping halfway.
Spoon marinara into an oven dish, layer eggplant slices and fresh mozzarella, then repeat until filled.
Bake casserole another 20-25 minutes until sauce bubbles and cheese melts; let rest before slicing into six portions.
Pack baked eggplant parmesan with measured spaghetti; add fresh basil when serving. Coating not fully retained may inflate estimated macros.

components.name: Wholewheat Spaghetti

ingredients.name: Dry wholewheat spaghetti for a complete meal

steps: Meanwhile cook dry wholewheat pasta just until tender, drain and toss with a little of the measured tomato sauce if available.
